people.name: Lakshminarayana
people.appearance: Broad forehead, squared cheeks, straight nose, short neatly clipped black moustache, clean chin, medium strong build, calm direct gaze.
people.costume: Honey-gold muga-look short-sleeve hip-length Chutia sula, narrow red stepped geometric edging, ivory Churia dhoti with a single red border, deep vermilion Tongali waist sash.
people.head: Ivory wrapped paguri following the local man's construction, medium-height folded end, narrow gold band with small rectangular central plaque.
people.jewellery: Small round gold studs, one modest round pendant on a fine chain, one narrow engraved cuff.
people.prop: Optional separate inset of a plain fired brick and copper-plate grant; neither held in the standard turnaround, no invented readable inscription.
people.evidence: Local records connect him with a 1401 grant. Bhismaknagar associations and the inscribed-brick reading require care; the official gazetteer offers a devotional reading of the words. The builder appearance is a design cue, not a proven personality.
people.identity: warm gold, stepped red border, rectangular brow plaque

people.name: Durlabhnarayana (Chutia)
people.appearance: Long substantial face, wide jaw, heavy eyelids, broad nose, thick short moustache greying at ends, heavier build, composed authoritative expression.
people.costume: Muted madder-red short-sleeve Chutia sula with fine ivory-and-gold double-line edging, ivory dhoti with a narrow ochre border, ochre-gold waist sash.
people.head: Ivory paguri with a broader low fold and a flat gold band, no upright metal crown.
people.jewellery: One medium gold-bead necklace with a small central bead, small gold earrings and paired narrow gold wrist cuffs.
people.prop: Optional separate copper-plate-grant inset, not a royal sceptre.
people.evidence: Catalogue records a 1428 grant. Do not confuse with Durlabhnarayan of Kamata. Apparent age, build and costume are invented.
people.identity: red upper garment, ochre sash, long heavy face

people.name: Muktadharmanarayana
people.appearance: Youthful oval face, slightly pointed chin, straight thick eyebrows, clean-shaven, lean build and alert but composed gaze.
people.costume: Luminous ivory pat-look short-sleeve Chutia sula with small red chevron edging, white dhoti with a hairline red edge, warm pale-gold sash with narrow red ends.
people.head: Compact ivory paguri using the same reference fold at smaller scale, thin gold band without a large frontal plaque.
people.jewellery: Tiny gold ear studs and one small pendant; plain wrist thread, no armlets or layered chains.
people.prop: None in the eight views; optional plain brick inset only for a later construction scene.
people.evidence: 1442 shrine-wall record; readings include Mukta Dharmanarayana and yuva-Dharmanarayana/son-regent. The catalogue calls him king while the older brief calls him prince. Design as a young royal without claiming an exact accession stage or documented age.
people.identity: young clean-shaven face, small headwrap, light gold sash

people.name: Pratyaksanarayana
people.appearance: Round face, rounded nose tip, deep-set eyes, short close beard and moustache, stocky compact build, still reserved expression.
people.costume: Deep indigo short-sleeve Chutia sula, narrow ivory diamond border with one red line, off-white dhoti with restrained red edging, red waist sash.
people.head: Ivory paguri with a low folded end and plain narrow gold band.
people.jewellery: Small gold earrings, single plain gold neck ring or short bead strand, one narrow cuff; no elaborate pendant.
people.evidence: Undated postscripts and variant names complicate identification. Keep this catalogue identity visually distinct, but do not claim a separate authenticated portrait or secure reign dates.
people.identity: indigo upper garment, round bearded face, diamond border

people.name: Yasamanarayana
people.appearance: Narrow face, high cheekbones, receding hairline under wrap, fine grey moustache, clean chin, slim build and mild natural stoop, watchful expression.
people.costume: Pale natural-gold silk short-sleeve Chutia sula, maroon-and-gold narrow repeated-line edging, soft ivory dhoti with maroon border, dark wine-red waist sash.
people.head: Ivory paguri with a neat small upright fold, engraved gold band and tiny central round plaque.
people.jewellery: Two restrained short gold/bead strands, small round gold earrings and a pair of modest engraved cuffs. No religious bead type or forehead mark assigned.
people.prop: None; no prayer beads implying an undocumented religious identity.
people.evidence: Late genealogical identification and possible overlap with Yasanarayana are uncertain. Distinct design is for the separate existing record, not evidence of two different individuals.
people.identity: slim older grey-moustached face, pale gold and wine palette

people.name: Purandarnarayana
people.appearance: Broad strong jaw, thick brows, slightly hooked nose, clean-shaven, broad shoulders and powerful build, upright decisive bearing.
people.costume: Deep wine-red short-sleeve Chutia sula with fine gold-and-ivory geometric hem edging, warm cream dhoti with double red lines, dark crimson waist sash with small gold clasp. No quilted vest.
people.head: Ivory paguri, compact firm folds, engraved low gold band with a modest central disc.
people.jewellery: Medium gold pendant, small gold earrings, paired gold cuffs and one narrow gold upper-arm band, visible but restrained.
people.prop: A modest sheathed sword at waist, using current Dhirnarayan's project design for continuity; no sword in hand, no claim that he was a documented military ruler.
people.evidence: Listed before Dhirnarayan in the project; few events are securely attached. Martial bearing and sword are creative cues only, not a sourced biography.
people.identity: broad clean-shaven jaw, richer dark red, waist sword

people.name: Kasitora
people.appearance: Long weathered face, broad nose, uneven greying stubble, sun-lined cheeks, wiry strong build, direct practical expression; no invented battle scar.
people.costume: Matte dark earth-brown cotton short-sleeve Chutia sula with plain muted-red edging, undyed off-white dhoti with narrow brown edge, russet waist sash. No padded vest or fantasy armour.
people.head: Low compact cream headwrap, plain cloth tie, no gold brow band.
people.jewellery: No royal jewellery; one plain brass wrist ring at most, simple utilitarian waist fastening.
people.prop: Small plain sheathed sword with dark wooden hilt, restrained fittings.
people.evidence: Catalogue describes a minister associated with the final conflict; confidence remains low. Practical soldier-minister styling is interpretation, not a recovered uniform.
people.identity: matte cotton, low plain headwrap, no gold

people.name: Sadhaknarayan
people.appearance: Slender long youthful face, soft jaw, wide-set eyes, smooth clean-shaven cheeks, narrow shoulders and graceful upright posture, composed rather than distressed.
people.costume: Fine light-cream short-sleeve Chutia sula with a hairline muted-red woven edge, white dhoti with narrow red hem, soft brick-red sash with simple handwoven ends.
people.head: Small ivory paguri with short folded end and a discreet gold fastening pin, no circlet.
people.jewellery: One tiny gold pendant and small plain gold studs; no armlets or heavy cuffs.
people.prop: None. Depict a prince in ordinary dignified court clothing, not a captive or impoverished exile.
people.evidence: A prince associated with the fall of the kingdom; accounts differ over his fate. Age 22 is an adult design choice. Neither execution nor deportation is asserted in the costume.
people.identity: very light cream, plain brick sash, youthful long clean-shaven face
